low_volume_boost.rationale: Small +3 conviction boost compensates for the information disadvantage of thin-liquidity TWSE stocks (3M-5M volume) by recognizing that even modest volume participation signals emerging interest in neglected names
low_volume_boost.todo: Calibrate: backtest against TWSE historical breakout patterns (2024-2026 daily data) to validate precision of low-vol boost

reject_low_volume_floor.rationale: Hard rejection threshold at 5M shares for breakout candidates with 'reject low volume' prompt; prevents low-liquidity TWSE names from entering the pipeline when structure-first filtering is required
reject_low_volume_floor.todo: Calibrate: backtest against TWSE historical breakout patterns (2024-2026 daily data) to calibrate false-breakout rejection rate

volume_boost.rationale: +8 conviction boost when volume meets the 5M default floor and prompt requests volume confirmation; rewards TWSE breakouts backed by sufficient participation, distinguishing genuine institutional interest from noise
volume_boost.todo: Calibrate: backtest against TWSE historical breakout patterns (2024-2026 daily data) across 6/8/10 values

close_strength_penalty.rationale: Small -1 conviction penalty for weak close (last < high×0.985) to mildly flag TWSE intraday reversals where breakout fails to hold near highs, indicating potential distribution rather than accumulation
close_strength_penalty.todo: Calibrate: backtest against TWSE historical breakout patterns (2024-2026 daily data) to validate magnitude

close_strength_threshold.rationale: 1.5% below intraday high (last < high×0.985) triggers weak-close penalty; calibrated to TWSE typical intraday range where a close below 98.5% of high suggests selling pressure overwhelmed breakout momentum
close_strength_threshold.todo: Calibrate: backtest against TWSE historical breakout patterns (2024-2026 daily data) across 0.980/0.985/0.990

close_strength_tolerance.rationale: 2% tolerance band (last >= high×0.98) exempts close from penalty when tolerance is enabled; prevents over-penalizing TWSE stocks that close modestly below highs but still within acceptable reversal range
close_strength_tolerance.todo: Calibrate: backtest against TWSE historical breakout patterns (2024-2026 daily data) to optimize tolerance band

surge_boost.rationale: +4 conviction boost when volume meets the strict surge floor (7M+); confirms that TWSE breakout is backed by abnormally high participation, signaling strong institutional conviction in the move
surge_boost.todo: Calibrate: backtest against TWSE historical breakout patterns (2024-2026 daily data) across 3/4/5 values

surge_penalty.rationale: -4 conviction penalty when volume fails to meet strict surge floor despite surge requirement; flags TWSE breakouts that lack the expected institutional volume, indicating potential bull trap
surge_penalty.todo: Calibrate: backtest against TWSE historical breakout patterns (2024-2026 daily data) to calibrate false-surge penalty

open_rejection_penalty.rationale: -10 conviction penalty when last < open under structure-first breakout filter; a strong TWSE intraday reversal below opening price indicates selling dominated the session, invalidating the breakout thesis
open_rejection_penalty.todo: Calibrate: backtest against TWSE historical breakout patterns (2024-2026 daily data) to validate false-breakout rate

late_breakout_penalty.rationale: -8 conviction penalty for late-session breakout fade (last < high×0.998); TWSE late-day reversals suggest exhaustion or program selling rather than sustained buying, reducing breakout credibility
late_breakout_penalty.todo: Calibrate: backtest against TWSE historical breakout patterns (2024-2026 daily data) across 6/8/10 values

late_breakout_threshold.rationale: 0.2% below intraday high (last < high×0.998) triggers late-breakout penalty; TWSE closing within 0.2% of high is acceptable, but failure to hold this level signals intraday distribution
late_breakout_threshold.todo: Calibrate: backtest against TWSE historical breakout patterns (2024-2026 daily data) across 0.995/0.998/0.999

confirmation_boost.rationale: +12 conviction boost for confirmed breakout (last >= high×0.998 AND volume >= 5M); dual-confirmation of price holding near highs with institutional volume is the strongest TWSE breakout signal
confirmation_boost.todo: Calibrate: backtest against TWSE historical breakout patterns (2024-2026 daily data) across 10/12/14 values

confirmation_threshold.rationale: 99.8% of intraday high required for confirmation boost; ensures TWSE close is essentially at or above the session high, validating that breakout momentum persisted through the close
confirmation_threshold.todo: Calibrate: backtest against TWSE historical breakout patterns (2024-2026 daily data) to optimize confirmation quality

catch_up_boost.rationale: +6 conviction boost for catch-up momentum (last in 0.993-0.998×high range, above open); identifies TWSE stocks mounting an intraday recovery that hasn't yet reached full breakout, offering early entry opportunity
catch_up_boost.todo: Calibrate: backtest against TWSE historical breakout patterns (2024-2026 daily data) across 4/6/8 values

catch_up_lower_threshold.rationale: 0.7% below high (last >= high×0.993) is the lower bound for catch-up momentum detection; TWSE stocks recovering to within 0.7% of highs show meaningful buying interest resuming after a pullback
catch_up_lower_threshold.todo: Calibrate: backtest against TWSE historical breakout patterns (2024-2026 daily data) to optimize catch-up zone

catch_up_upper_threshold.rationale: 0.2% below high (last < high×0.998) is the upper bound for catch-up zone; stocks above this level are classified as confirmed breakouts rather than catch-up candidates, avoiding overlap with ConfirmationBoost
catch_up_upper_threshold.todo: Calibrate: backtest against TWSE historical breakout patterns (2024-2026 daily data) to optimize catch-up zone

conviction_base.rationale: Moderate starting conviction for growth-momentum style; lower than sector base (60) because growth picks carry higher earnings-volatility risk requiring more confirmatory signals before full confidence
conviction_base.todo: Calibrate from backtest: compare hit rates at base 40/45/50 across growth-momentum picks

price_penalty.rationale: Intraday weakness penalty: when last < open the closing buyer lost control, signalling potential distribution in growth names that rely on sustained buying pressure
price_penalty.todo: Calibrate 6/8/10 via cross-executor backtest sweep comparing forward returns on penalized vs non-penalized picks

trend_confirmation_penalty.rationale: Heavy penalty when prompt demands trend confirmation but price closes below open, indicating the trend hypothesis is contradicted by intraday price action
trend_confirmation_penalty.todo: Backtest 12/15/18 to measure false-trend-filter precision at each penalty level

downgrade_price_penalty.rationale: Price-based downgrade penalty: when last falls below high×threshold (0.995), the stock failed to hold its peak, signalling potential reversal from a downgrade event
downgrade_price_penalty.todo: Calibrate 10/12/14: compare downgrade penalty hit rate against post-downgrade 5-day forward returns

downgrade_open_penalty.rationale: Open-based downgrade penalty: when last < open alongside downgrade signals, intraday selling pressure compounds the downgrade thesis with visible bearish conviction
downgrade_open_penalty.todo: Backtest 6/8/10: measure whether open-penalty adds discriminative value beyond price-penalty alone

exploratory_price_penalty.rationale: Reduced price penalty for exploratory-mode picks (6 vs standard 12); exploratory signals have wider hypothesis space so equal-weighting full downgrade penalty would over-penalize novel growth candidates
exploratory_price_penalty.todo: Monitor exploratory vs standard penalty hit rates separately; merge if statistically indistinguishable

exploratory_open_penalty.rationale: Reduced open penalty for exploratory mode (4 vs standard 8); acknowledges higher uncertainty tolerance when probing nascent growth themes before trend is established
exploratory_open_penalty.todo: Track exploratory-penalty cohort performance vs standard cohort to calibrate optimal discount factor

downgrade_threshold.rationale: Downgrade trigger threshold: last < high×0.995 means a 0.5% drop from session high, sensitive enough to catch early distribution in high-momentum names without false-triggering on noise
downgrade_threshold.todo: Calibrate 0.990/0.995/0.998: measure false-positive rate at each threshold on growth-momentum backtest universe

momentum_high_threshold.rationale: Momentum factor score ≥0.4 triggers high-conviction delta (+8); top 20% of TWSE momentum distribution, used by TechnicalBreakout for breakout-confirmed momentum picks
momentum_high_threshold.todo: Calibrate 0.3/0.4/0.5 against TWSE momentum-quintile forward returns; higher threshold increases selectivity

momentum_high_delta.rationale: +8 conviction boost for strong momentum (>0.4); magnitude reflects momentum factor's historical 60-65% hit rate on TWSE mid/large-cap universe over 20-day forward window
momentum_high_delta.todo: Calibrate 6/8/10: measure hit-rate uplift per delta increment on backtest

momentum_mod_threshold.rationale: Momentum score ≥0.15 triggers moderate delta (+4); captures above-median momentum stocks (40th-80th percentile), used by TechnicalBreakout for standard picks and Shipping for BDI-cycle entries
momentum_mod_threshold.todo: Calibrate 0.10/0.15/0.20 against TWSE momentum moderate-tier hit rate and false-positive rate

momentum_mod_delta.rationale: +4 conviction boost for moderate momentum; conservative half-weighting relative to high tier reflects lower signal strength at median momentum levels where noise increases
momentum_mod_delta.todo: Calibrate 3/4/5: verify linearity of delta-to-forward-return relationship

momentum_weak_threshold.rationale: Momentum score ≤-0.1 triggers penalty (-4); identifies negative-momentum TWSE stocks where trend has reversed, protecting against value-trap entries in declining names
momentum_weak_threshold.todo: Calibrate -0.15/-0.10/-0.05: compare penalty-hit rate against subsequent drawdown severity

momentum_weak_delta.rationale: -4 conviction penalty for weak/negative momentum; symmetric to moderate delta (+4) reflecting equal conviction adjustment magnitude in both directions
momentum_weak_delta.todo: Calibrate -5/-4/-3: validate symmetry assumption against TWSE bear-regime momentum patterns

value_high_threshold.rationale: Value factor score ≥0.3 triggers high-conviction delta (+8); captured by ValueYield executor for deep-value picks with strong P/B and P/E discounts on TWSE
value_high_threshold.todo: Calibrate 0.25/0.30/0.40 against TWSE value-quintile forward returns and value-premium persistence

value_high_delta.rationale: +8 conviction boost for deep value (>0.3); TW value premium averages 3-5% annual excess return in top value quintile, warranting conviction proportional to momentum boost
value_high_delta.todo: Calibrate 6/8/10: measure hit-rate uplift and alpha contribution per delta increment

value_mod_threshold.rationale: Value score ≥0.1 triggers moderate delta (+4); above-median value used by Financials (bank valuations) and ValueYield (broad value screening) for moderate conviction
value_mod_threshold.todo: Calibrate 0.05/0.10/0.15 against TWSE value moderate-tier forward returns; optimize for Sharpe improvement

value_mod_delta.rationale: +4 conviction boost for moderate value; consistent with momentum moderate delta, maintaining factor-weight symmetry across the multi-factor scoring framework
value_mod_delta.todo: Calibrate 3/4/5: validate cross-factor delta consistency improves overall portfolio Sharpe

value_weak_threshold.rationale: Value score ≤-0.2 triggers penalty (-5); flags overvalued stocks (negative value factor) where premium valuations lack fundamental support, common in TW growth-bubble names
value_weak_threshold.todo: Calibrate -0.25/-0.20/-0.15: compare penalty-hit rate against value-trap false-positive rate

value_weak_delta.rationale: -5 conviction penalty for negative value factor; slightly larger magnitude than momentum weak (-4) because value-factor reversals tend to be more persistent in TW market
value_weak_delta.todo: Calibrate -6/-5/-4: verify value-penalty asymmetry improves risk-adjusted returns vs symmetric approach

quality_threshold.rationale: Quality factor score ≥0.2 triggers +4 delta; captures firms with strong ROE, low accruals, and stable margins — used by ValueYield, EarningsQuality, and Financials executors
quality_threshold.todo: Calibrate 0.15/0.20/0.30 against quality-quintile forward returns on TWSE; higher threshold increases purity

quality_delta.rationale: +4 conviction boost for quality; matches moderate-tier delta convention across all factors, ensuring uniform factor-weight contribution scaling
quality_delta.todo: Calibrate 3/4/5: validate hit-rate improvement per delta increment in quality-sorted TWSE backtest

liquidity_high_threshold.rationale: Liquidity score ≥0.5 triggers +5 delta; identifies highly liquid TWSE stocks (top quartile turnover, tight spreads) where execution risk is minimal — used by TechnicalBreakout for volume-confirmed entries
liquidity_high_threshold.todo: Calibrate 0.4/0.5/0.6 against liquidity-quartile execution slippage and fill-rate data

liquidity_high_delta.rationale: +5 conviction boost for high liquidity; slightly higher than standard moderate delta (+4) because liquidity directly reduces execution costs, providing a tangible alpha enhancement
liquidity_high_delta.todo: Calibrate 4/5/6: measure alpha contribution of liquidity boost vs execution-cost savings

liquidity_good_threshold.rationale: Liquidity score ≥0.2 triggers +3 delta; adequate liquidity for institutional-sized TWSE orders without significant market impact — used by TechnicalBreakout and ETFRotation executors
liquidity_good_threshold.todo: Calibrate 0.15/0.20/0.30 against TWSE institutional order market-impact models

liquidity_good_delta.rationale: +3 conviction boost for adequate liquidity; modest delta reflecting that good liquidity enables but doesn't generate alpha — it removes a constraint rather than adding edge
liquidity_good_delta.todo: Calibrate 2/3/4: verify marginal benefit of liquidity boost beyond execution-cost reduction

liquidity_low_threshold.rationale: Liquidity score ≤-0.3 triggers -5 penalty; identifies stocks where bid-ask spreads and turnover indicate prohibitive execution costs (>50bp estimated slippage) for institutional positions
liquidity_low_threshold.todo: Calibrate -0.35/-0.30/-0.20 against TWSE low-liquidity stock execution-cost and fill-failure data

liquidity_low_delta.rationale: -5 conviction penalty for insufficient liquidity; magnitude reflects that poor liquidity can turn a good signal into a losing trade through slippage, making it a first-order risk factor
liquidity_low_delta.todo: Calibrate -6/-5/-4: validate penalty magnitude against actual TWSE slippage costs in low-liquidity regime

min_cash_threshold.rationale: Minimum cash reserve before triggering low-cash warning

max_positions_count.rationale: Maximum number of open positions before concentration warning

max_unrealized_loss_pct.rationale: Unrealized loss threshold (-5%) before position warning

slippage_warning_bps.rationale: Trade slippage warning threshold (50 BPS = 0.5%) — emits WARNING severity alert

max_alert_trigger_rate.rationale: Maximum alert trigger rate per hour before critical

var_limit_pct.rationale: VaR 不得超過組合價值 2%

min_cash_buffer_pct.rationale: 至少保留 5% 現金緩衝

max_correlation.rationale: 與現有持倉相關性 > 0.7 則降低權重

min_adv_ratio.rationale: 下單量不得超過日均量 1%

max_open_positions.rationale: 最多同時持有 5 檔標的，控制集中度風險

stop_loss_pct.rationale: 個股虧損達 10% 即止損

take_profit_pct.rationale: 個股獲利達 30% 考慮部分獲利了結

volatility_spike_mult.rationale: 波動率超過 3 倍歷史均值 → 減碼

circuit_breaker_daily_loss_pct.rationale: 單日組合虧損 5% → 暫停交易

consecutive_loss_days.rationale: 連續虧損 5 天 → mute agent

carry_trade_unwind_threshold.rationale: JPY/USD above 145 triggers carry trade unwind concern; TW market foreign outflow accelerates above this threshold

vix_threshold.rationale: VIX above 30 indicates global fear regime triggering TW foreign capital outflow

us10y_threshold.rationale: US 10Y above 4.5% signals rate-driven capital reallocation from EM equities; TW market shows sensitivity at this level

oil_shock_threshold_pct.rationale: 10% oil price surge triggers supply-chain cost shock for TW manufacturing; historical shocks: 2022 Ukraine (+30%), 2023 OPEC cut (+8%)

gold_surge_threshold_pct.rationale: 5% gold surge signals risk-off flight to safety, correlating with TW equity outflows
gold_surge_threshold_pct.todo: Validate against gold-USD-TWD correlation during 2022-2026 risk events

dxy_surge_threshold_pct.rationale: 1.5% DXY surge signals USD strength that pressures EM currencies including TWD; TW exporters face FX headwind

twd_stress_threshold_pct.rationale: 2% TWD depreciation in a session signals capital flight; TW central bank typically intervenes at this level

outflow_prob_base.rationale: 35% baseline foreign outflow probability under normal conditions; calibrated from TWSE foreign flow data 2020-2025

outflow_prob_max.rationale: 80% max outflow probability under extreme conditions; upper bound observed during 2020 COVID and 2022 rate shock

min_trend_strength.rationale: Minimum 0.7 trend strength for structural classification; below this threshold trends are considered noise
min_trend_strength.todo: Calibrate against TW structural trend detection accuracy 2020-2026

min_confidence.rationale: 75% minimum confidence for structural trend signal; balances false positive rate vs early detection

min_hit_rate.rationale: 70% minimum historical hit rate for narrative events to be considered valid structural trends
min_hit_rate.todo: Validate against narrative event hit rate distribution

override_threshold.rationale: 0.65 threshold for structural trend to override cyclical signals; must be lower than MinConfidence to prioritize structure

ai_revenue_growth_threshold.rationale: 50% YoY AI revenue growth threshold flags structural AI capex surge; TSMC AI revenue grew ~50% in 2024-2025

cowos_utilization_threshold.rationale: 85% CoWoS utilization signals near-capacity AI packaging demand; TSMC CoWoS utilization tracked at 90%+ in 2025

capex_growth_threshold.rationale: 40% YoY capex growth flags structural capacity expansion; TSMC capex grew ~34% in 2024, ~40% planned for 2025

semiconductor_index_threshold.rationale: Placeholder for semiconductor index trend threshold; pending index construction

orange_override_min_score.rationale: Minimum composite score for orange (moderate) drawdown override of agent recommendations

red_override_min_score.rationale: Minimum composite score for red (severe/emergency) drawdown override; must be > OrangeOverrideMinScore

sector_constraints_risk_off.rationale: Risk-off sector constraints: AI supply chain cut to 30% of normal, small cap/EM near-zero; gold/utilities boosted as defensive rotation

sector_constraints_carry_trade_unwind.rationale: Carry trade unwind constraints: equities severely curtailed (5-10%), cash doubled; based on 2024 JPY carry unwind impact on TW markets

sector_constraints_sector_rotation.rationale: Sector rotation constraints: energy/oil services boosted 1.5-1.8x on commodity surge; high-valuation tech and rate-sensitives cut to 30-40%

max_allocation.rationale: Maximum 40% single-sector allocation prevents over-concentration; ~2x semiconductor base weight (19%) allows tactical overweight

rebalance_threshold.rationale: 1% rebalance threshold avoids excessive trading; sector weight deviation must exceed 1% to trigger rebalance

cooldown_period_hours.rationale: 24-hour cooldown between strategy switches prevents whipsaw during volatile regime transitions

vix_momentum_crash_threshold.rationale: VIX above 30 signals momentum crash regime; TW market foreign flow sensitivity increases ~3x above this level

crowding_penalty_agents_3.rationale: When 3 agents crowd same stock, conviction reduced to 75% to prevent herding; based on Kelly criterion adjustment for correlated bets

crowding_penalty_agents_4.rationale: When 4+ agents crowd same stock, conviction reduced to 60%; exponential penalty as crowding increases

min_trade_amount.rationale: 100K TWD minimum trade amount filters out uneconomically small orders; ~$3K USD at current FX

max_stocks_default.rationale: Default 8 stocks max per session balances diversification with position concentration; aligned with baseline MaxOpenPositions (5) + buffer

max_stocks_min.rationale: Minimum 5 stocks ensures basic sector diversification across semiconductor, AI, financials, shipping, and one defensive

max_stocks_max.rationale: Maximum 12 stocks prevents over-diversification diluting alpha; above 12, marginal diversification benefit < transaction cost

conviction_floor_default.rationale: Minimum 50 conviction (out of 100) for executor recommendations to be considered; below 50 is effectively a coin flip
conviction_floor_default.todo: Calibrate floor against executor historical precision-recall curve

neutral_regime_sizing_factor.rationale: 85% position sizing in neutral regime reduces max position from full weight to 85%; provides 15% buffer for regime uncertainty

win_rate_threshold.rationale: 0.2% cost-adjusted threshold for win-rate classification. Covers transaction cost (~0.15% in TW market) + slippage buffer. ForwardReturn must exceed this to count as a win.

sharpe_min_samples.rationale: Minimum 5 per-agent forward-return samples before SharpeLike is reported. Below this, statistical significance is poor and the value is shown as N/A on the frontend.

top_n.rationale: Default universe size of 150 names; Oracle recommends 120-180 dynamic range, with bear-market override to 100-120

pe_weight.rationale: Oracle-calibrated weight for valuation factor; retained despite Taiwan PE distortion from semiconductors

pb_weight.rationale: Oracle-calibrated weight for book-value factor; important for financials screening

volume_weight.rationale: Oracle-calibrated weight reduced from 0.20 to 0.15 to make room for the foreign-flow factor

momentum_weight.rationale: Oracle-calibrated weight reduced sharply from 0.30 to 0.15 because Taiwan momentum reverses quickly

quality_weight.rationale: Oracle-calibrated weight combining ROE, ROA and accruals quality

foreign_flow_weight.rationale: Oracle-calibrated new foreign-investor flow factor; core driver for Taiwan equities

volume_floor_twd.rationale: Minimum daily turnover of NT$10M replaces share-count floor to avoid low-priced stocks passing a 100-lot screen

min_daily_amount_twd.rationale: Relaxed Layer-2.5 re-check floor of NT$5M for liquidity verification before final inclusion

max_industry_concentration.rationale: Oracle-recommended 40% cap to avoid semiconductor over-concentration in the universe

price_minimum.rationale: Minimum stock price of NT$10 for universe eligibility

factor_score_max_age_days.rationale: Factor scores older than 30 days are downgraded to avoid stale inputs

d6_expiry_trading_days.rationale: Unselected Layer-2 candidates remain on the D6 watchlist for 60 trading days before expiry

var_contribution_multiplier.rationale: Exclude names with VaR contribution above 2x the portfolio average

volatility_multiplier.rationale: Exclude names with 30-day realized volatility above 2x the median

drawdown_threshold.rationale: 30% drawdown threshold for risk flag (flag only, not exclusion)

confidence_threshold.rationale: Minimum of 3 supporting signals or confidence points required for inclusion

supply_chain_expand_depth.rationale: Expand supply-chain mapping up to 2 hops when building representative stock sets

risk_on_mean.rationale: Risk-on regime expected positive daily drift on TWSE; long-term equity premium

risk_off_mean.rationale: Risk-off regime near-zero drift reflects defensive positioning

risk_on_std_dev.rationale: Risk-on regime 1.5% daily vol matches typical TWSE large-cap

risk_off_std_dev.rationale: Risk-off regime 0.8% daily vol reflects compressed trading ranges
